fusions.name: Bellyflop Landing
fusions.desc: Springs your ride into the air and brings it down on every enemy within 3 tiles. It deals 13 damage, knocks them back 2.5 tiles and leaves them [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Tongue From the Cab
fusions.desc: Lashes a sticky tongue from your seat at a target up to 6 tiles away. It deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times that at the far end of its reach, and slows the target by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Clutch Spring
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 25% for 6 seconds. You spring 3 tiles from where you stood as it starts.

fusions.name: Next Lily Pad
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 15 stamina. Once every 4 seconds. You also gain +5% dodge chance.
